newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Moscow strip club owner shot dead.
newsitem.headline: Moscow strip club owner shot dead.

text.p: The owner of a Moscow strip club was shot dead on Sunday outside his premises, just a few blocks from the White House government building, police said on Monday.

In Russia's latest mafia-style hit, the owner of "Dolls", a fashionable haunt for Moscow's brash new rich, was shot in the head as he stepped out into busy Presnya Street. He died in hospital. Police identified him only by his surname, Glotser.
Such killings are now commonplace in Russian cities. A bomb blast killed the head of a commercial firm and wounded his two bodyguards on Friday just two blocks from the strip club.
